headline: Congress named the post office at 123 East Main Street in Vergas, Minnesota, the "Jon Glawe Post Office."
what_it_does: This law renames a U.S. Postal Service facility in Vergas, Minnesota, after Jon Glawe. It changes only the official name of the building. It does not change postal services, mail delivery, or postal rules.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 27, 2022, and the name change took effect on that date.
